extensions.org.licoland.adapter.claude-code/purpose: The Claude Code adapter: the CLI stream-json driver and the vendor protocol that classifies one lf-ndjson line exactly once below the adapter port, plus the Subagent MCP caller registration an installed Claude Code client uses. The kernel owns no part of Claude Code and depends on none of it.
extensions.org.licoland.adapter.claude-code/persist: This package declares no conversion because it owns no persisted package data of its own: it writes no data home, no cache and no store. The Claude Code transcript the CLI keeps belongs to the installed Claude Code client, and the client's own conversation store remains the kernel's.
